picks.name: Crippling Headshot
picks.annotation: Best item in the game for damage as it shreds resists so your entire team will do more damage. And anti-heal is so good.

picks.name: Hunter's Aura
picks.annotation: Great for one v ones. Probably the best 3.2k weapon item for your 4.8k weapon investment.

picks.name: Colossus
picks.annotation: Melee damadge and tankiness. Pick between this and Ethereal Shift for your last active slot, or sell Dispel Magic.

picks.name: Juggernaut
picks.annotation: Great against gun carries and is good to pick up if you have no free slots.

picks.name: Spellbreaker
picks.annotation: Incredible against Lash, Grey Talon, and any other spirit burst characters.

picks.name: Scourge
picks.annotation: Usually after Arctic Blast. Makes you really tanky and can do a lot of damage if you get into the middle of their team. You can rush earlier if you feel it would be good or have the money.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Anti-heal + more burst damage. If you need to burst carries this is really useful.

picks.name: Ethereal Shift
picks.annotation: They doubled the CD on it so it's way worse, still might be good though on Calico. Helps you live much longer. Great with Transcendent CD. You can skip for more damage if you're not dying.

picks.name: Escalating Exposure
picks.annotation: This with Scourge is insane. You run into the middle of the enemy team with Scourge and they take like 2-4k damage. Also has shred and gives you even more spirit resist so you're even tankier.

picks.name: Boundless Spirit
picks.annotation: Gives you some much needed damage in the late game with your ult and gloom bombs. Great if you are trying to oneshot their carries.

picks.name: Focus Lens

I love cat[girl]s! Skelly's Spirit Assassin Build

1437614329.annotation: Very common buy. Great healing in lane from punching minions. And we can optionally upgrade this into Lifestrike for more sustain.

98582110.annotation: Great damage and stats in lane and gives you move speed for chasing. The foostep sound reduction is also nice. And this gives you wallhacks from the DoT. This is also for the weapon investment bonus.

465043967.annotation: We upgrade this to Spirit Snatch later. Adds to our burst.

1976391348.annotation: Adds to your burst damage, and the slow is great. We also can upgrade this into Arctic Blast.

3399065363.annotation: Must buy for rotating around the map and ganking other lanes. Builds into Enduring Speed for our Vitality investment spike.

2447176615.annotation: Great for move speed in fights and the slow resist. Hits your 4.8k vitality investment.

395944548.annotation: Great damage over the course of a game/fight. And makes you a little tankier. Also helps with farming. Just super good core item for us. Gets us our 4.8k spirit investment.

3731635960.annotation: Must buy against Slowing Hex. Really great against a ton of characters, especially Vindicta, Infernus, Bebop and others who debuff you. Also great for spirit resist now.

1710079648.annotation: Great for healing if you get really low in lane. Sprint speed is also nice for rotating. If you're going to buy one of these situational healing items, get this one since it stays useful after lane.

2481177645.annotation: Great for one v ones. Probably the best 3.2k weapon item for your 4.8k weapon investment.

3190916303.annotation: large damage spike and procs off your 2.

3261353684.annotation: Cooldown reduction is really useful. Gives you way more uptime.

915014646.annotation: Great item once you have 2 actives. It also makes Torment Pulse tick faster! Very good with Ethereal Shift in particular.

3005970438.annotation: This with Scourge is insane. You run into the middle of the enemy team with Scourge and they take like 2-4k damage. Also has shred and gives you even more spirit resist so you're even tankier.

1047818222.annotation: Good if you need debuff reduction and are going to build Spellbreaker later (good if they have heavy spirit burst such as Grey Talon or Lash).

1414025773.annotation: Great against certain characters and abilities. Especially Lash.

1644605047.annotation: Great item and good in many lanes. And late game has good spirit scaling, and ends up being like a 500+ barrier.

3633614685.annotation: 210 health is kinda insane early, so you could get this in lane. We build this into Fortitude.

343572757.annotation: Anti-heal + more burst damage. If you need to burst carries this is really useful.

3812615317.annotation: Really great item, great for catching people and for clearing waves in cat form. The combo with it is Arctic Blast, 2 immediately so the AB travels with you, light punch, 1, 4.

2417568017.annotation: Usually after Arctic Blast. Makes you really tanky and can do a lot of damage if you get into the middle of their team. You can rush earlier if you feel it would be good or have the money.

2407781327.annotation: Melee damadge and tankiness. Pick between this and Ethereal Shift for your last active slot, or sell Dispel Magic.

2533252781.annotation: They doubled the CD on it so it's way worse, still might be good though on Calico. Helps you live much longer. Great with Transcendent CD. You can skip for more damage if you're not dying.

3357231760.annotation: Really great in late teamfights. Especially good if you are really struggling against CC. Or for midboss.

1955841979.annotation: Incredible against Lash, Grey Talon, and any other spirit burst characters.

1250307611.annotation: Great against gun carries and is good to pick up if you have no free slots.

1342610602.annotation: Worth going early now for Point Blank if you prefer that. Nice for melee resist as well.

3074274290.annotation: DO NOT EVER BUILD THIS UNLESS YOU ARE 100% SURE YOU WILL GET LOTS OF STACKS. This is often a trap item, which puts you -3k souls down, without giving you anything much in return until later.

2095565695.annotation: Feels pretty good. It is now fixed for your 2! Difficult on slots though. Good for melee resist if you need that.

2603935618.annotation: Easy to proc anti-heal. The heal on kill is also really great during midgame fights.

1235347618.annotation: Good item at the moment, the bullet resist and regen is great in lane. Later though you should just get Bullet Resilience. Also good for farming denizens.

1798666702.annotation: goes really well with hollow point (also u can sell fortitude or enduring speed at this point)

1414319208.annotation: if you are even and/or going against a tanky team

2163598980.annotation: If you need anti-spirit. Very common buy although not absolutely necessary since we build many items that have spirit resist already. Really strong at the moment.

3585132399.annotation: The health is great for survivability, the move speed is great for rotating, and the heal lets you stay on the map longer. I prefer this over VW cause it works in the tunnels.

1378931225.annotation: This since it got buffed is actually kinda really good against some characters, especially Haze and Drifter. I'd get this as an alternative to Bullet Resilience or Plated Armor. Good with trans CD

3884003354.annotation: Best item in the game for damage as it shreds resists so your entire team will do more damage. And anti-heal is so good.

3403085434.annotation: Not as good since the speed stacking nerf. I still like it though. Good for movespeed in ult and catform. Combine with a 3.2k weapon item to get your 4.8k investment spike.

2059712766.annotation: 10% spirit resist for 1.6k and the health and the stamina is really nice.

3491236900.annotation: Great but usually only buy once you already have bullet resist. Great against Haze.

3361811174.annotation: If you are actually like the only player on your team doing anything and you have like 65k souls you could get this.

1371725689.annotation: Good for shutting down fliers and gun carries. And for getting on top of the people you need to target in team fights.

2829638276.annotation: Worse than the other lane healing items imo. Plus if you're getting Lifestrike it's useless.

4204808176.annotation: Great against Viscous in lane since it works against Viscous Puddle Punches. Also a very good item against people building melee (Abrams and Billy). Only buy if you can actually parry consistently.

7409189.annotation: Great for damage in lane on your bombs. The regen it gives is also nice. With T2 bombs this gets them to over 80 damage which will proc Mystic Burst.

380806748.annotation: You can put this on your 2 or your 4, depends on what you want. 2 is better for snowballing, 4 is better for being able to fight more.

3140772621.annotation: For bullet resist. If it's early, probably just go Battle Vest instead though. If it's late and you've got Transcendent Cooldown I would just go Metal Skin instead.

865958998.annotation: Alternative to Fortitude. Really nice for rotating around the map, ganking, escaping/survivability, and the heal is great. I don't like this too much since it doesn't work in the tunnels.

3970837787.annotation: Great for more spirit resist early. Cooldown reduction is really rare so this is a great item since it gives you some.

112198670.annotation: Great against spirit damage. You can get in some lanes.

619484391.annotation: Good item. Very common buy. Silence is very good against many characters and since it's an AoE it can hit many people in a teamfight.

1925087134.annotation: Great at stopping gun carries. Easy to proc and can proc on many people.

1813726886.annotation: Good against Mina, and other movement focused people.

1219329868.annotation: Builds into Focus Lens, easy to use and great for 1v1s. Makes your burst way stronger.

1396247347.annotation: Great for damage and ammo, repalces Stalker.

2081037738.annotation: Upgrades into Escalating Exposure. Spirit shred is extremely useful.

2519598785.annotation: Gives you some much needed damage in the late game with your ult and gloom bombs. Great if you are trying to oneshot their carries.

2142980412.annotation: Quite strong at the moment, shred is good.

3028234315.annotation: Kind of a meme item. Very situational. Only get against lots of incremental spirit damage (McGinnis turrets, Infernus, Warden Ult) and have Spirit Resilience already.

1282141666.annotation: Might be quite nice against tanks if you've gone into more gun late game.

334300056.annotation: fun item, good value, mmm mmmmovement. You could buy this in the mid game some time rather than getting resists perhaps.

3270001687.annotation: Good for movement and the bullet resist is nice.

2617435668.annotation: If you really need to screw over someone in particular.

2121044373.annotation: ONLY GET AFTER ARCTIC BLAST. Tankbuster tool tip lies and it actually procs with items such as Arctic Blast. Decent for more burst damage but I don't like it much.

2800629741.annotation: Fun and silly! Also good escape tool. Just worse to get than other 6ks though.

2947183272.annotation: Kind of fun, but not very good. Adds up to a decent amount of heal in longer fights since Torment Pulse and Scourge easily procs it.

1292979587.annotation: It's nice on your bombs. You like all the things it gives you. But before you get Arctic Blast, the bombs are inconsistent to hit, and your bombs don't have that good spirit scaling.

1254091416.annotation: If no one else on your team is going to buy this and you really need to stop a Vindicta/GT or Seven ult.

3144988365.annotation: I don't think this is really all that worth it compared to just getting Healbane. Since any person incredibly reliant on healing will just get Debuff Remover. But maybe get against Mo or Abrams.

1102081447.annotation: Just feels really nice, makes it super easy to hit your ults second/end damage burst. Probably also nice against like Vyper.

1998374645.annotation: Your bombs can't really proc this anymore. So you can only proc it with Cold Front/Arctic Blast and your ult.

3361075077.annotation: Decent item against certain gun carries.

805079544.annotation: It's nice, but I just prefer to go Return Fire or Suppressor or rush Bullet Resilience early.

2226497419.annotation: If you're going more into gun later then this might be good.

709540378.annotation: Possible item for your 4.8k Weapon Investment, but imo it's not that necessary on Calico.

1009965641.annotation: Good if enemies are pushing to your tower or you need to push and take objectives.
